name: SUPERVISOR
function: Global supervisor FSM, microcode ROM, watchdog

name: TIMING
stage: single owner of MEM_nCE/nOE/nWE and the ACK handshake

name: MEMORY
stage: all feature maps, weights, biases, quant params and LUT/map ROMs

name: CONV1
stage: C1 stage; requant is on-board, C1_ACC never leaves the board

name: POOL1
stage: P1 stage; POOL_SEL tied 0, IN_DATA1 byte buffer on-board

name: CONV2
stage: C2 stage; requant is on-board, C2_ACC never leaves the board

name: POOL2
stage: P2 stage; POOL_SEL tied 1, IN_DATA2 byte buffer on-board

name: FC1
stage: FC1 stage; FC_SEL tied 0, FC1_ACC/FC1_REQ_* stay on-board

name: FC2
function: 32 -> 10 fully connected + FC2 raw signed32 requant
stage: FC2 stage; FC_SEL tied 1, FC2_ACC/FC2_REQ_* stay on-board

name: ARGMAX
stage: final stage; four score bytes assembled on-board

name: BUSFAB
function: Master/region encode, map ROM, REQ/WE merge, engine merge
stage: arbitration only; FC1/FC2 and POOL1/POOL2 are muxed into the S11 slots

name: HOSTIO
function: Host connector, clock/reset, image and weight load ports
stage: the only board with the external host interface
